justification: Wuhan reference spike sequence. Matches the sequence used in the original mRNA vaccine formulations administered during the period in which most reported myocarditis cases occurred, and matches the sequence used in both predecessor studies this project reassesses (Kanduc-lineage linear peptide-sharing analyses; eBioMedicine structural/sequence comparison). Variant spike sequences are explicitly out of scope for this study.

Cardiac alpha-myosin heavy chain. Named as a candidate cross-reactive target in Kanduc-lineage linear peptide-sharing analyses. Included in the eBioMedicine structural/sequence null-result comparison. Distinct from MYH7 (beta-myosin heavy chain) — verified explicitly to avoid isoform confusion.
Cardiac-disease-linked tropomyosin alpha-1 isoform, predominant tropomyosin isoform in striated/cardiac muscle. Named explicitly in Kanduc-lineage mimicry analyses and in the eBioMedicine comparison.
Cardiac-disease-linked tropomyosin alpha-3 isoform (gamma-Tm). Named alongside TPM1 in both predecessor investigations this study reassesses.
Cardiac alpha-actin. Binding partner of the tropomyosin isoforms above in the sarcomeric thin filament; named in the same predecessor mimicry literature as a candidate cardiac autoantigen.
